# Fixture faculty guide with an overclaimed professor row

This fixture models the failure the plan calls "a handbook claim of global professor editing":
the row grants the scoped role actions the policy reserves for editors and administrators.

## Role boundary

| Role | Allowed actions (policy) |
| --- | --- |
| professor | `create`, `edit`, `submit`, `publish`, `copy-forward`, `grant-scope`, `settings` |
| delegate | `create`, `edit`, `submit` |
